expected: T001 must emit traceable F04 Registry evidence (F04-EVT-001 capability_selected, F04-EVT-002 capability_rejected, F04-EVT-006 capability_gap, F04-EVT-007 registry_mismatch) through the canonical F07 evidence validator, carrying capability_version and registry_version (F04-AC-017/018, proof_scope RUNTIME_EVIDENCE). F04-RQ-002/003/004 define capability_id as lowercase namespace.name and capability_version / registry_version as SemVer (e.g. layout.container, 1.0.0), and F04 section 25 lists capability_version + registry_version as minimum F04 evidence dimensions.
actual: The locked BS-P1-003 evidence-event-registry.json property_schemas contain double-escaped regex patterns. After JSON parsing, the pattern strings contain a literal backslash pair (e.g. capability_version = '^(0|[1-9]\\d*)\\.(0|[1-9]\\d*)...'), so new RegExp() requires a literal backslash character in the value. The canonical validator (src/platform/evidence/evidence-validator.ts via evidence-registry.ts) therefore rejects every valid F04 value: capability_version '1.0.0', registry_version '1.0.0' and property capability_id 'layout.container' all return F07-ERR-003. As a result, no F04 event can carry capability_version or registry_version through the canonical evidence path, so F04-AC-018 is unsatisfiable under BS-P1-003 without reinterpreting the locked contract. Secondary: property registry_digest requires '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$', while the canonical Registry computeRegistryDigest() emits bare 64-hex; the locked F04 contract does not define the digest string representation, so mapping between them is also undecided.
